title: philotheca buxifolia subsp. obovata
intro: Philotheca buxifolia subsp. obovata, commonly known as the 'Yellow Box', is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It is traditionally used in Australian bush medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions of wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Philotheca buxifolia subsp. obovata include flavonoids, limonoids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing.
